info.title: EthersFlow Autonomous Agent Trust & Consensus API
info.description: Enterprise-grade multi-model federated adversarial consensus and agent action verification engine (v0.4.0 Provably Independent Council). Drop-in compatible with standard OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs.

BearerAuth.description: Single-Key Access Model: Your account-bound EthersFlow API key (ef_live_... or ef_sandbox_...) is the ONLY credential required for verification, MCP, and usage metering. Create a free account at https://www.ethersflow.com/api-keys.html to mint a key. Optional per-seat BYOK headers (X-BYOK-Groq-Key, X-BYOK-OpenRouter-Key, X-BYOK-OpenAI-Key, X-BYOK-NVIDIA-Key) are supported but never required.

AccountSessionAuth.description: Signed account session token returned by POST /api/v1/auth/signup or POST /api/v1/auth/login. Required for all /api/v1/keys/* key provisioning, listing, rotation, revocation, and audit log endpoints.

PolicyRules.description: Structured policy rules evaluated by the deterministic policy kernel and auto-match compiler. Safe unmapped custom rule keys (e.g. geo_fence_regions) are preserved and trigger fail-closed review (UNMAPPED_POLICY_RULE_DETECTED). Any fail-open, bypass, or ALLOW_* error-branch directive is rejected with HTTP 400 POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED.

status.description: Policy lifecycle state. Deprecated or superseded policies emit policy_current: false and STALE_POLICY_BINDING on verify.

superseded_by.description: Optional replacement policy_id surfaced on verify when this policy is superseded.

on_gate_error.description: Non-overridable safety directive governing upstream/gateway errors. Normalized to top-level on storage.

on_timeout.description: Non-overridable safety directive governing council timeout paths. Normalized to top-level on storage.

on_unmapped_rule.description: Non-overridable safety directive governing unmapped custom rule keys. Normalized to top-level on storage.

policy_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical ASCII key-sorted normalized policy object ({ id, version, persona_preset, on_gate_error, on_timeout, on_unmapped_rule, rules, custom_instructions }), always bound into receipt_v2.policy_hash. Pre-0.3.3 stored custom policies are migrated on load with default FAIL_CLOSED safety directives and re-stamped (prior hash retained in legacy_policy_hash). Intentionally excludes compiler_version so compiler upgrades never alter policy_hash or invalidate historical receipts.

legacy_policy_hash.description: Present on pre-0.3.3 custom policies migrated on load to preserve historical hash reconstructability.

validation_errors.description: Deduplicated list of policy safety violations sorted deterministically in ASCII alphabetical order by field path (tie-breaking on reason_code, then message).

PersonasDerivedObject.description: Deterministic auto-match compiler provenance stamped on every verification verdict.

auto_matched.description: True when the compiler's derived council roles executed directly (custom/inline policy with no explicit persona override).

override_applied.description: True when the caller supplied explicit persona_preset, custom_personas, or persona_instructions overriding auto-match.

GatewayUpstreamUnreachableError.description: Non-overridable Layer 2 runtime fail-closed response returned whenever all upstream council providers fail or time out during CONSENSUS lane evaluation, regardless of attached policy content.

name.example: DeFi Smart Contract & Bridge Risk Council

ScopeGrantObject.description: Server-minted, Ed25519-signed delegated capability grant registered via POST /api/v1/scope-grants. Self-attested or unregistered grants fail closed on /api/v1/verify with FORGED_OR_UNREGISTERED_SCOPE_GRANT.

grant_signature.description: Ed25519 signature binding grant_id, caller_scope, preset, subject_id, authorized_by, and expires_at.

CouncilProvenance.description: Strict cross-family council diversity telemetry (diversity_policy=strict_cross_family_v1). Gemini 2.5 Flash is excluded from production council rotation.

diversity_degraded.description: True whenever the council could not seat distinct model families across active seats; always paired with reason_code DIVERSITY_DEGRADED.

SingleKeyAccessModel.description: Explicit single-key access contract: one EthersFlow API key grants verify/MCP access and the hosted multi-model council. BYOK is strictly optional.

MeteringSummary.description: Per-verdict cost, token, and access-model attribution echoed on every /api/v1/verify response.

AccountUsageReport.description: Authenticated, tenant-isolated account or key usage metering report with lane split, per-model/family token & USD cost attribution, custom policy counts, and mathematical reconciliation checks.

UsageExportJson.description: Ed25519-signed billing reconciliation export broken down per day x key x lane x model x provider x billing_mode.

ModelPricingSchedule.description: Public per-model cost schedule reflecting free-tier Nemotron seats, Groq LPU seats, GPT-4o Mini, Fast Path kernel, and optional BYOK passthrough.

post.description: Drop-in OpenAI SDK proxy endpoint. Intercepts prompt, executes multi-model adversarial consensus in parallel, enforces zero data retention (ZDR), and returns synthesized response with consensus audit metadata.

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-Council
parameters.description: JSON array of custom analyst roles (e.g. ['Fiduciary Auditor', 'SEC Compliance', 'Skeptic'])

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-Agent-Count
parameters.description: Number of parallel adversarial audit nodes (2 to 7, default 3)

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-Zero-Retention
parameters.description: Enforce client-side PII token masking and zero logging across all nodes

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-SLA-Timeout
parameters.description: SLA latency budget target in milliseconds (e.g. 2500)

parameters.name: X-EthersFlow-Callback-URL
parameters.description: Webhook URL for asynchronous consensus delivery (returns HTTP 202 immediately)

200.description: Standard OpenAI Chat Completion with Top-Level & Choice-Level EthersFlow Consensus Metadata

202.description: Asynchronous Consensus Task Queued (Dispatched to background pipeline and delivered via webhook)

post.description: Drop-in Anthropic SDK (@anthropic-ai/sdk) proxy endpoint. Pass baseURL 'https://www.ethersflow.com'.

200.description: Standard Anthropic Message Response with Top-Level EthersFlow Consensus Metadata

post.description: Gates an agent decision (e.g., execute_trade, send_email, approve_claim) using deterministic policy pre-screening and heterogeneous multi-model adversarial cross-examination. Supports caller-scoped 24h verdict idempotency (Option B) and echoes contractual request_id, trace_id, idempotency_key, client_reference_id, and latency_ms across every response.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key (or pass idempotency_key in JSON body). Echoed in every response and deduplicates verdict issuance per (caller_key, idempotency_key) for 24 hours.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Optional caller correlation reference (or pass client_reference_id / correlation_id in JSON body) echoed back as client_reference_id for human-in-the-loop audit linkage.

parameters.name: X-BYOK-Groq-Key
parameters.description: OPTIONAL add-on (never required). Supply your own Groq API key for Groq-hosted council seats; EthersFlow bills $0.00 token cost for BYOK seats (gate attestation fee only).

parameters.name: X-BYOK-OpenRouter-Key
parameters.description: OPTIONAL add-on (never required). Supply your own OpenRouter API key for OpenRouter-routed council seats.

parameters.name: X-BYOK-OpenAI-Key
parameters.description: OPTIONAL add-on (never required). Supply your own OpenAI API key for OpenAI-hosted council seats.

parameters.name: X-BYOK-NVIDIA-Key
parameters.description: OPTIONAL add-on (never required). Supply your own NVIDIA NIM API key for Nemotron council seats.

agent_action.example: Execute $250,000 wire transfer to Vendor X

reasoning_chain.example: Invoice PO-8841 matched vendor payment record; approval threshold under $500k auto-limit.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client idempotency key. Echoed verbatim at top level and deduplicates verdict issuance per caller key for 24 hours (replays return replayed: true and original_request_id; reusing the same key with a different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT). Downstream mutation idempotency remains the mutation caller's responsibility.

client_reference_id.description: Optional workflow or ticket correlation ID (alias: correlation_id) echoed top-level to simplify audit linkage across async human-in-the-loop branches.

persona_preset.description: Built-in audit preset (clinical_safety, financial_compliance, legal_citation, cybersecurity_auditor, general_adversarial), a registered custom persona ID/slug created via POST /api/v1/personas, or an arbitrary custom label when paired with inline custom_personas / persona_instructions.

custom_personas.description: Optional inline array of custom analyst role strings or objects ({ role, instructions }) used for flexible domain councils without pre-registration.

persona_instructions.description: Optional inline domain audit instructions injected into all council reviewer prompts.

context.description: Structured contextual evidence, metadata, scope grant, or source document references.

scope_grant.description: Platform-registered cryptographic capability grant provisioned via POST /api/v1/scope-grants (pass { grant_id, grant_signature }). Self-attested, unregistered, expired, cross-caller, or revoked grants fail closed with FORGED_OR_UNREGISTERED_SCOPE_GRANT (CRITICAL_BLOCK).

subject_scope_grant.description: Direct subject scope authorization object (alias of scope_grant).

policy_id.description: System policy ID (e.g. 'finops_default_v1') or caller-registered custom policy ID from POST /api/v1/policies. Deleted custom policy IDs fail closed with HTTP 410 POLICY_DELETED; deprecated/superseded policies emit policy_current: false and STALE_POLICY_BINDING.

policy.description: Optional inline custom policy override object (supports max_amount_usd, require_human_review_above_usd, blocked_verbs, blocked_keywords, allowed_domains, blocked_domains, require_ticket_anchor, fast_path_allowed, default_verdict_on_violation, custom_instructions).

prefer_fast_path.description: Advisory hint; never bypasses council safety gates. Whenever lane evaluates as CONSENSUS, fast_path_ineligibility_reasons[] reports every deterministic condition that required live council review.

request_id.description: Contractual top-level verification request identifier (bound inside Ed25519 attestation).

verdict_id.description: Alias of request_id for downstream ledger linkage.

idempotency_key.description: Echoed caller idempotency_key (or Idempotency-Key header); null when omitted.

client_reference_id.description: Echoed caller correlation reference if supplied.

replayed.description: True when served from the 24h caller-scoped idempotency cache.

original_request_id.description: Present on replayed responses; equals request_id of the original verdict.

lane.description: FAST_PATH triggers ONLY when: (1) policy rules.fast_path_allowed !== false, zero custom rule violations, zero unmapped_rules, and zero custom_instructions/custom_personas; AND (2) either Read-Only Observability Fast-Path (preset in cybersecurity_auditor|general_adversarial|legal_citation, whitelisted read-only verb, zero external destination/egress/mutation, amount=0) OR FinOps Micro Fast-Path (preset=financial_compliance, clean safety screen, zero external destination/mutation, and micro-purchase <=$25 or reconciled PO/ticket/counterparty anchored <=$100).

fast_path_ineligibility_reasons.description: Empty array on FAST_PATH verdicts; lists exact deterministic gating reasons whenever lane=CONSENSUS.

warnings.description: Structured non-fatal operational warnings (e.g. STALE_POLICY_BINDING, DIVERSITY_DEGRADED).

compiler_version.description: Version of the deterministic auto-match persona compiler; also recorded in receipt_v2.config_tuple.compiler_version.

unmapped_rules.description: Alphabetically sorted unmapped custom rule keys detected in the attached policy (never silently dropped; forces CONSENSUS review with UNMAPPED_POLICY_RULE_DETECTED).

policy_current.description: True when the bound policy is active; false when deprecated or superseded (always paired with STALE_POLICY_BINDING).

receipt_v2.description: Signed receipt envelope containing policy_hash, signing_key_id, actual_models, models_digest, diversity_degraded, and config_tuple (policy_id, policy_version, compiler_version, diversity_policy, revision, catalog_version, aggregation_rule_version).

latency_ms.description: Server-side gateway evaluation duration in milliseconds.

400.description: Malformed Request, Schema Error, or Fail-Open Policy Rejection (caller key authenticated first; e.g. POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_PERSONA_PRESET, INVALID_AGENT_COUNT, MISSING_AGENT_ACTION)

401.description: Authentication Failed (MISSING_AUTHORIZATION, MALFORMED_AUTHORIZATION_HEADER, REVOKED_API_KEY, ROTATED_API_KEY, or INVALID_API_KEY)

403.description: Key Scope Mismatch (e.g. MIS_SCOPED_API_KEY when sandbox demo token is sent to live /api/v1/verify)

409.description: Idempotency Conflict (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT when the same idempotency_key is reused for different request parameters)

410.description: Referenced Custom Policy Was Deleted (POLICY_DELETED — policy_current: false, status: FAIL_CLOSED, verdict: REJECTED, action_eligible: false, approval_blocked: true)

502.description: Upstream Council Providers Unreachable — Non-overridable runtime fail-closed invariant (GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE: status=FAIL_CLOSED, verdict=REJECTED, action_eligible=false, approval_blocked=true).

post.summary: Sandbox Agent Action Verification (Full Live Council Parity)
post.description: Executes the exact same heterogeneous multi-model council, deterministic auto-match compiler, and fail-closed policy kernel as live /api/v1/verify. Differs only in sandbox_mode: true, req_sandbox_/trace_sandbox_ ID prefixes, acceptance of the static demo token ef_sandbox_demo_show_hn, and ephemeral sandbox key quotas (60 verdicts/hr, 24h TTL).

200.description: Sandbox verification verdict receipt with contractual request_id, trace_id, idempotency_key, compiler_version, personas_derived, and latency_ms.

400.description: Schema validation error or fail-open inline policy rejection (POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED).

502.description: Upstream Council Providers Unreachable — Non-overridable runtime fail-closed invariant (GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE: status=FAIL_CLOSED, verdict=REJECTED, action_eligible=false, approval_blocked=true).

201.description: Account created and signed session token issued.

400.description: Invalid email or password shorter than 8 characters.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

post.description: Authenticates an existing EthersFlow account and returns a signed account session token for /api/v1/keys/* operations.

200.description: Authenticated and signed session token issued.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account profile for the active session token.

post.description: Immediately revokes the caller's signed account session token.

get.description: Returns masked metadata for API keys belonging to the authenticated EthersFlow account. Raw key secrets are never returned after initial creation.
Returns verification audit log entries scoped strictly to the authenticated EthersFlow account.

post.description: Provisions an ephemeral ef_sandbox_... Bearer key bound to the authenticated EthersFlow account (24h TTL, 60 verdicts/hr). Requires a valid account session token; unauthenticated requests fail closed with 401 ACCOUNT_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED.

200.description: Account-bound ephemeral sandbox API key issued (shown once).

post.description: Provisions a new active ef_live_... Bearer key bound to an authenticated EthersFlow account. Raw key secret is returned once and stored as a SHA-256 hash only.

200.description: Issued API key object (raw key shown once).

200.description: Successor key issued (raw key shown once).

post.description: Immediately revokes an active key; subsequent verify calls with that token fail closed with 401 REVOKED_API_KEY.
Native MCP Server endpoint enabling LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGPT, Claude, or Cloudflare Workers to invoke EthersFlow verification as a tool.

200.description: MCP Protocol Standard JSON-RPC Response (verdict payload inside result.content[0].text)

400.description: MCP Invalid Params (-32602), including POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED on inline fail-open policies, INVALID_PERSONA_PRESET, or INVALID_AGENT_COUNT (auth checked first).

502.description: Upstream Council Providers Unreachable (-32002) — Non-overridable runtime fail-closed invariant (error.data carries GatewayUpstreamUnreachableError with status=FAIL_CLOSED, verdict=REJECTED, action_eligible=false, approval_blocked=true).

get.description: Returns read-only built-in system policies together with all custom verification policies created by the authenticated caller.

post.description: Creates a reusable governance policy evaluated at runtime inside POST /api/v1/verify and bound cryptographically via canonical normalized policy_hash in receipt_v2. Rejects any fail-open, bypass, or ALLOW_* error-branch directive with HTTP 400 POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED.

id.description: Optional slug identifier; auto-generated if omitted.

strict_rules.description: When true, rejects policies that have all rule fields and custom_instructions empty with HTTP 400 EMPTY_POLICY_RULES.

201.description: Created custom policy with normalized FAIL_CLOSED directives, canonical policy_hash, effective_rules echo, has_active_rules boolean, and warnings[] (including EMPTY_POLICY_RULES_SILENT_DEFAULTS if all rule dimensions are empty/default).

400.description: Validation error (POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED on fail-open directives, EMPTY_POLICY_RULES when strict_rules=true, or MISSING_POLICY_NAME)

200.description: Updated policy with refreshed canonical policy_hash
Updated policy with refreshed canonical policy_hash

get.summary: Preview Deterministic Auto-Match Personas for Policy
get.description: Pure deterministic compiler preview (zero LLM calls). Maps normalized policy JSON rule categories to the exact auditor persona set, council_roles, unmapped_rules, policy_hash, and compiler_version before running POST /api/v1/verify.
Returns built-in system auditor presets plus all caller-registered custom personas usable as persona_preset on POST /api/v1/verify.

get.description: Public read-only catalog listing all 10 council models, model families, runtime eligibility, strict_cross_family_v1 diversity enforcement policy, and confirmation that Gemini 2.5 Flash is excluded from production council rotation.
Returns all cryptographic capability grants provisioned by the authenticated caller.

post.summary: Register Cryptographically Signed Scope Grant (D5 Anti-Forgery Path)
post.description: Provisions a caller-scoped, Ed25519-signed capability grant (grant_id + grant_signature) usable on POST /api/v1/verify. Self-attested or unregistered grants fail closed with FORGED_OR_UNREGISTERED_SCOPE_GRANT.

400.description: Invalid scope grant fields or non-future expiry

get.summary: Get Caller Scope Grant by ID

404.description: Scope grant not found for this caller

delete.description: Immediately revokes a registered scope grant. Subsequent /api/v1/verify calls presenting a revoked grant fail closed with FORGED_OR_UNREGISTERED_SCOPE_GRANT.

404.description: Scope grant not found for this caller

get.summary: Public Ed25519 JWKS Discovery (RFC 8037 OKP Profile)
get.description: Public unauthenticated JWKS endpoint publishing EthersFlow's active Ed25519 receipt-signing public key (kty: OKP, crv: Ed25519). Aliased at /.well-known/ethersflow-jwks.json and /.well-known/attestation.json.

get.summary: Get Account or Key Usage Metering Report (Authenticated)
get.description: Returns tenant-isolated, time-windowed usage metering broken down by lane (FAST_PATH vs CONSENSUS), model, model family, API key, and day, including token consumption, per-model USD cost attribution, custom policy counts, and mathematical reconciliation checks. Enforces auth-before-schema (HTTP 401 on missing/invalid key, HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN_KEY_SCOPE on cross-account key_id) with Cache-Control: no-store, private.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Roll up across all keys in the authenticated account (default) or restrict strictly to the calling key.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Predefined lookback window (ignored when from/to are supplied).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Optional ISO-8601 start date or timestamp (e.g. 2026-11-01).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional ISO-8601 end date or timestamp.

parameters.name: key_id
parameters.description: Filter to a specific key_id belonging to your authenticated account (returns 403 FORBIDDEN_KEY_SCOPE for foreign keys).

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Optional model family filter (e.g. qwen, gpt-oss, nemotron, ethersflow_kernel).

200.description: Account or key usage metering report with reconciled period totals

400.description: Invalid scope, time window, or date range

401.description: Missing or invalid EthersFlow API key (auth-before-schema)

403.description: Requested key_id does not belong to the authenticated account (FORBIDDEN_KEY_SCOPE)

get.summary: Export Billing Reconciliation Usage Report (CSV or Ed25519-Signed JSON)
get.description: Authenticated period export broken down per day x key x lane x model x provider x billing_mode for finance reconciliation. Default format=csv returns RFC-4180 formula-injection-safe CSV with X-EthersFlow-Reconciliation-* headers; format=json returns an Ed25519-signed reconciliation ledger.

200.description: CSV attachment (text/csv) or Ed25519-signed JSON export

400.description: Invalid format, scope, or time range

401.description: Missing or invalid EthersFlow API key (auth-before-schema)

403.description: Requested key_id does not belong to the authenticated account (FORBIDDEN_KEY_SCOPE)

get.summary: Retrieve Public Per-Model Cost Schedule & Single-Key Access Model
get.description: Public rate card listing per-1M input/output token rates and cryptographic attestation seat fees for all 10 council models plus the ethersflow_kernel Fast Path, alongside the explicit single-key access model.

get.summary: Retrieve Signing Public Key (JWK, PEM, SPKI DER, Hex)
get.description: Public endpoint returning EthersFlow's active Ed25519 signing public key in JWK, raw hex, SPKI DER hex, and PEM formats alongside canonical_serialization_spec.

200.description: Public key descriptor and canonical serialization specification
